# third_party/protobuf

Well-known Protocol Buffer types used by `protoc` code generation.

Source: [protocolbuffers/protobuf v29.3](https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf/tree/v29.3/src/google/protobuf)

These files are vendored so CI and local builds do not depend on system packages
shipping `google/protobuf/*.proto` include paths.
